test_title: PYST 32: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 11 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the given sentence.**

She became __frantic__ as she lost her purse on the busy streets of the markets.
solution: The correct answer is: **Agitated** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word '**frantic**' means extremely worried or panicked. (अत्यधिक चिंतित या घबराया हुआ) • **Example**: *As the deadline approached, she became frantic, searching for her misplaced notes in a flurry of panic.* • The synonym of 'frantic' is '**agitated**', which means feeling or appearing troubled or nervous. (परेशान या घबराया हुआ महसूस करना या दिखना) • **Example**: *The agitated crowd grew increasingly frantic as they awaited news about the unfolding situation.* Therefore, **Option 4** is the correct answer. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Hectic **means full of activity, confusion, or commotion. (गतिविधि, भ्रम या हंगामे से भरा हुआ) • **Composed **means having one's feelings and expression under control; calm. (अपनी भावनाओं और अभिव्यक्ति को नियंत्रण में रखना; शांत) • **Audacious **means showing a willingness to take surprisingly bold risks; showing an impudent lack of respect. (आश्चर्यजनक रूप से साहसिक जोखिम लेने की इच्छा; सम्मान की कमी दिखा रहा है) 3f:T69f, The correct answer is: "**has impacted the way we consume**."
